# One-time product pricing — every region

<!-- GENERATED by the shared fetch-iap-pricing.py (iboalali-apps kit) — do not hand-edit. -->

A snapshot of what Play currently charges, mirrored down from the Console. Re-run
`fetch-iap-pricing.py` after any price change; the per-product JSON beside this file
is the machine-readable form (and the rollback / fetch-then-merge base).

Prices are exactly as Play stores them: **in local currency, and tax-inclusive in the regions
where Play quotes tax-inclusive prices** (India's figure includes 18% GST, for instance). They
are therefore *not* directly comparable across regions without backing tax out first.

currency between versions), so always take currencies from this snapshot rather than assuming.
